title: The Loud Storm, the Quiet Bill: What Typhoon Champi Says About Taiwan's Power and Refining Assets
detail: Champi peaked at 185 mph and shut Taiwan's markets for a day, yet the ClimRisk engine prices cyclone damage at about 3% of a northern Taiwan plant's value to 2050 — the carbon price is the number that moves it.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
